text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, and learning to handle them well reduces stress. The first step is effective time management. Break large projects into smaller, daily tasks, and use a calendar to track your progress. Next, practice prioritization. Not all tasks are equally important, so focus on what is both urgent and essential first. Another key skill is scope management. It is easy for a simple task to grow in size, so clearly define what is included and be willing to say no to extra requests. Finally, maintain open communication. If you see a problem early, tell your manager or team. This builds trust and allows everyone to adjust plans together.
